policy: Compute results locally; do not use external simulator rankings as truth or calibration targets.

blizzard.label: Blizzard development notes, including 27 October supplement

datamine.label: Talents Forever: first-hand client and hotfix-cache comparison
datamine.kind: community client extraction; not independently reproduced here

changes.old: No cooldown in the model; cast on successive frozen charges.
changes.current: 8-second cooldown. Latest cache reports +300% frozen damage (4x total), superseding the mid-October +200% version.
changes.impact: Rebuild charge spending and cooldown scheduling; the old Ice Lance contribution cannot carry forward.

changes.old: Up to +10 percentage points of Frostbolt / Ice Lance crit.
changes.current: No crit bonus. Each stack adds 20% damage taken from the next Cone of Cold and 7% spell-damage scaling, up to five stacks.
changes.impact: Remove the old crit ramp; model stacking, consumption and whether the target is in Cone of Cold range. This does not prove the net size of Frost's change.

changes.old: Defensive shield; absent from the recommended 18/3/30 raid build.
changes.current: 15% Frost damage for one minute, with another 5% while shielded, according to the hotfix cache.
changes.impact: Deep Frost must be re-optimized with barrier uptime and shield breaks. Ignoring this gain would bias the comparison against Frost.

changes.old: 2.5-second Blast; +10% damage stacks consumed by other spells; no Wrath rotation.
changes.current: Blast: 1.5-second cast, +12% Intellect as spell damage per stack, four stacks, 18 seconds from first application, +100% Blast mana cost per stack. Wrath is a new spell.
changes.impact: The old cycle optimizer describes a different ability. Evaluate buff maintenance, Wrath, Missiles and mana together; cheap stacks alone do not establish Arcane as best.
implemented_components: Arcane Blast stack lifetime, cap, Intellect bonus and next-cast base mana cost in patch_rules.py and patch-rules.js
changes.remaining: Not integrated into raid, dice, leveling or AoE engines. Wrath, damage ranks/coefficients, aura timing, proc and mana interactions remain pending.

changes.old: Static Fire Power and the old Heating Up / Fire Blast behavior.
changes.current: Fire Power depends on personal Fire effects, capped at 12%; Fire Blast supplies an extra Heating Up stack. Accelerant also shortens Arcane Wrath.
changes.impact: Re-evaluate DoT / Scorch uptime, Pyroblast timing, Fire Blast and Arcane hybrids using our own rotations and matched settings.

changes.old: 54-talent tree, Arcane Focus, Piercing Ice, five-rank Elemental Precision and old positions.
changes.current: Arcane Focus and Piercing Ice are gone; Precision gives all-school hit (2/4/6%). Missile Barrage has two ranks on row 2; Incineration has five and Critical Mass three. Other nodes move.
changes.impact: Rebuild talent data and presets before comparing trees. Old share links represent historical builds; do not silently reinterpret their points.
implemented_components: Isolated Precision hit bonus and Accelerant cast-time modifiers with rank validation in both languages
changes.remaining: Full tree, prerequisites, legality, presets, share-link versioning, hit cap and engine integration remain pending.

changes.old: Human sword crit, 1% Skyborne haste, charge-based Eureka!, frequent Undead procs.
changes.current: Human: 1% crit, 10% Spirit. Skyborne: 2% haste; raid attunement removed. Eureka!: eight seconds. Undead: 30% caster proc chance, 15-second internal cooldown. Troll: 15-second Berserking.
changes.impact: Withdraw old racial percentages. New rankings depend on the rebuilt rotations and mana model.

changes.old: Dungeon kill XP treated as unconfirmed; strong negative AoE verdict.
changes.current: Blizzard confirms dungeon kill XP and increased it approximately 20% on 8 October. Cone of Cold gained control on its first four targets; wands require 0.5 seconds stationary.
changes.impact: The unanswered question is XP per hour, not whether kills award XP. Re-test small packs and group runs; do not multiply open-world XP by 1.2.

changes.old: Reading only the 15 October notes would give obsolete values.
changes.current: Frost Blast is no longer trained. The later Missile Barrage tooltip excludes Arcane Missiles as a proc trigger. Latest Ice Lance and Winter's Chill values differ from mid-October notes.
changes.impact: Pin client tables and hotfix cache together. Preserve uncertain server behavior as test cases, not as confirmed implementation.

changes.old: Some coefficients, resistance and proc rules were borrowed from other simulators.
changes.current: Independent game-data or combat-log validation is pending.
changes.impact: Audit Ice Lance scaling, boss partial resistance, Fingers of Frost, mana regen, ranks and travel time. Keep explicit sensitivity ranges.

maintenance_note: No newer upstream commit or newer Mage patch found in the checked official forum listing and client extraction sources. Current source snapshot remains October 30 hotfix, read October 31 by the extractor.
